title: hordeum murinum subsp. leporinum
intro: Hordeum murinum subsp. leporinum, commonly known as wild barley or false barley, is a subspecies of the Hordeum murinum plant, a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Hordeum murinum subsp. leporinum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
